transcript.text: I need to raise a concern before we finalize this plan. During my current student-services file review, I identified active no-contact orders involving two students, Nia and Omar. Any peer-mediation referrals involving either of these students must be screened out of the program — they cannot be placed in mediation sessions together or with each other. I confirmed these orders with the families this week, but I have not yet added a screening requirement to the draft plan. I recommend we include an explicit screening step in the referral process to ensure no-contact orders are checked before any mediation session is scheduled.

This directly affects the draft plan's scope, which currently includes moderate conflicts and only one adult supervisor.
